title: Smoked Monkfish Tagliere
description: A flavorful dish that combines the delicate taste of monkfish with the rich flavors of smoked dutch cheese.
instructions: Season the monkfish fillets with salt and pepper. Place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

Roasted garlic: peel the garlic cloves and place them on a piece of aluminum foil, drizzle with olive oil and fold to create a packet. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the garlic is soft and mashed.
Sprinkle the smoked Dutch cheese crumbles over the monkfish fillets.
Bake the monkfish in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the monkfish is baking, toast the tagliere bread slices until crispy.
Remove the monkfish from the oven and top each fillet with a spoonful of roasted garlic.
Serve the monkfish on top of the toasted bread slices, garnished with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Enjoy immediately, while the cheese is still melted and the fish is warm.
